paragraphs.en: The group paused at the top of the hill, where the plateau sloped westward. From there, they could see the Cape of the Woods and a vast expanse of open sea to the east. The Spyglass stood above them, dotted with pines and cliffs.
paragraphs.zh: 众人停在山顶，这里地势向西倾斜。从这里望去，可以看到木头角和东方一片广阔的海域。望远镜号就矗立在他们上方，松树和峭壁点缀其间。

paragraphs.en: Only the distant waves and insect chirping broke the silence.
paragraphs.zh: 只有远处的海浪声和虫鸣打破了寂静。

paragraphs.en: Silver used his compass to take bearings. "There are three tall trees in line from Skeleton Island," he said. "Spy-glass shoulder is that lower point.
paragraphs.zh: 银色用指南针确定了方位。“从骷髅岛方向看，有三棵高大的树成一线排列。”他说道，“望远镜肩点就是那个较低的树梢位置。”

paragraphs.en: It's easy now to find what we need. I think I'll have my meal first."
paragraphs.zh: 现在找我们需要的东西很容易。我想先吃点东西。

paragraphs.en: Morgan grumbled, "I don't feel sharp today. Thinking of Flint—now that did me in."
paragraphs.zh: 摩根嘟囔道：“我今天感觉不太在状态。一想到弗林特，这可真把我给搞糊涂了。”

paragraphs.en: Silver replied, "Ah, well, my son, you should praise your stars he’s dead." Another pirate added, "Flint was an ugly devil, with that blue face too!"
paragraphs.zh: 银色回答道：“啊，好吧，我儿子，你应该感谢上天他死了。”另一个海盗补充说：“弗林特这人相貌丑陋，还有一张蓝色的脸！”

paragraphs.en: Merry agreed, "That was how the rum affected him. Blue! I reckon he was blue.
paragraphs.zh: 梅里同意道：“这酒可真让他情绪低落。蓝了！我想他是真的心情不好。”

paragraphs.en: That's a true word."
paragraphs.zh: 这是句实在话。

paragraphs.en: Since finding the skeleton, their conversation had grown quieter, almost to whispers. Suddenly, a thin, high voice sang out from the trees in front: "Fifteen men on the dead man's chest—Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum!"
paragraphs.zh: 自从发现那具骨架后，他们的谈话变得轻声细语，几乎成了耳语。突然间，前方树林中传来一个尖锐的声音：“十五个男人在死人的chest上——呀嗨呀嗨，再来一瓶朗姆酒！”

paragraphs.en: The pirates were visibly shaken; their faces paled as if by magic. Some leaped to their feet, others grabbed onto each other. Morgan fell to the ground.
paragraphs.zh: 海盗们显然被吓了一跳，脸色瞬间变得苍白。有的跳了起来，有的相互拉扯着。摩根则摔倒在地。

paragraphs.en: "It’s Flint!" cried Merry.
paragraphs.zh: “是弗林特！”梅里喊道。

paragraphs.en: The song abruptly ceased, as if someone had silenced the singer mid-note. In the clear air among the trees, it sounded sweet and airy. The effect on our companions was profound.
paragraphs.zh: 歌声突然戛然而止，仿佛有人在半音处中断了演唱。在这片树林间的清新空气中，歌声听起来格外甜美轻盈。对我们同伴们的影响极为深刻。

paragraphs.en: "Come," Silver urged, his courage returning. "This isn't right. Stand by to go about.
paragraphs.zh: “来吧，”锡尔弗催促道，勇气渐渐恢复，“这不对劲。准备好掉头吧。”

paragraphs.en: Someone is playing a prank—someone real."
paragraphs.zh: 有人在恶作剧——是真人做的。

paragraphs.en: The voice reappeared, this time not singing but calling faintly: "Darby M'Graw! Darby M'Graw!" and then, louder with an oath omitted.
paragraphs.zh: 这声音再次响起，这次不是唱歌而是微弱地呼唤：“达比·麦格劳！达比·麦格劳！”随后声音加大了一些，但似乎少了一句粗话。

paragraphs.en: The buccaneers stood rooted, their eyes wide in shock. Long after the voice faded, they stared silently ahead.
paragraphs.zh: 海盗们呆立在原地，惊愕得睁大了眼睛。声音消失很久后，他们仍默默盯着前方。

paragraphs.en: "That confirms it," one gasped. "Let's go."
paragraphs.zh: “这就确定了，”一个人喘息道，“我们走。”

paragraphs.en: "They were his last words," Morgan mourned. "His final words above board."
paragraphs.zh: “这是他最后的遗言，”莫根悲伤地说，“也是他最后一次光明正大地说话。”

paragraphs.en: Dick had his Bible open and was praying fervently. He came from a good background before he joined the sea and bad company.
paragraphs.zh: 狄克打开圣经，虔诚地祷告着。他原本出身良好，但在加入海上生活后，结识了一些不良之徒。

paragraphs.en: Silver remained unyielding. I could hear his teeth rattling, but he hadn't given up yet.
paragraphs.zh: 银色依旧坚持着。我能听到他牙齿打颤的声音，但显然他还远没有放弃。

paragraphs.en: "Nobody on this island ever heard of Darby," he muttered. "Not one of us except us." Then, with effort: "Shipmates, I'm here to get that stuff, and no man or devil will beat me.
paragraphs.zh: “这个岛上没人听说过达尔比，”他喃喃道，“除了我们这些船员之外。”随后，他努力说道：“船友们，我来这儿就是为了拿到那些东西，没有人，也没有魔鬼能阻止我。”

paragraphs.en: Flint never scared him alive, and by the powers, I'll face him dead. Seven hundred thousand pounds are just a quarter mile away. When did a gentleman of fortune ever show his back to such wealth for an old seaman with a blue mug—and one who's dead too?"
paragraphs.zh: 弗林特从未让他真正感到害怕，而我可不会因为他死了就退缩。七十万英镑就在半英里之外，一个有身份的绅士面对如此财富，怎么会因为一个蓝杯的老水手而转身离开呢——更何况他已经死了？

paragraphs.en: His followers showed no sign of renewed courage; instead, they grew more terrified by his irreverence.
paragraphs.zh: 他的追随者丝毫没有表现出重拾勇气的迹象，反而因为他的不敬而更加恐惧。

paragraphs.en: "Belay there, John!" Merry warned. "Don't cross a spirit."
paragraphs.zh: “约翰，住手！”梅里警告道，“别招惹精灵。”

paragraphs.en: John spoke with determination, though fear clung to him and his companions. "Sperrit? Maybe," he said, "but there's something I don't understand.
paragraphs.zh: 约翰下定决心地说，尽管恐惧 still 挂在他和同伴们的心头。“斯佩里特？也许吧，”他说，“但我有些事情不明白。

paragraphs.en: There was an echo. No man ever saw a sperrit with a shadow, so what’s it doing with an echo?"
paragraphs.zh: 回声传来。没有人见过有影子的幽灵，那么它怎么会有回声呢？

paragraphs.en: George Merry seemed relieved by John's argument. "You're right, John," he agreed. "Your head is sound.
paragraphs.zh: 乔治·梅里似乎被约翰的论点说服了。“你说得对，约翰，”他赞同道，“你的头脑很清楚。”

paragraphs.en: This crew is on the wrong path. Flint's voice might have sounded like that, but not as clear."
paragraphs.zh: 这支队伍走错了路。弗林特的声音可能听起来是这样的，但没有那么清晰。

paragraphs.en: Silver suddenly shouted, "By the powers, Ben Gunn!" Morgan quickly added, "Ben Gunn it was!"
paragraphs.zh: 银色突然喊道：“天哪，是本·古恩！”摩根迅速附和道：“就是本·古恩！”

paragraphs.en: Dick asked, "Does it matter? Ben Gunn isn't here anymore than Flint."
paragraphs.zh: 迪克问道：“这重要吗？本·古恩和弗林特一样，已经不在了。”

paragraphs.en: The older hands dismissed Dick’s comment with disdain. "Nobody minds Ben Gunn," Merry declared. "Dead or alive, nobody cares about him."
paragraphs.zh: 老练的船员们对迪克的话不屑一顾。“没有人介意本·古恩，”梅里断言道，“无论是死是活，没人会在乎他。”

paragraphs.en: Their spirits lifted as they resumed their conversation and work. Soon, they were chatting again, occasionally listening for sounds. After a while, hearing nothing more, they shouldered their tools and set off towards Skeleton Island, with Silver's compass guiding them.
paragraphs.zh: 他们的心情随之好转，重新开始了交谈和工作。很快，两人又聊了起来，偶尔侧耳倾听四周的动静。过了一会儿，没有听到任何异响后，他们扛起工具，跟着银的手表指引的方向，向骷髅岛进发了。

paragraphs.en: Dick still held his Bible, glancing around fearfully, but found no sympathy. Silver even joked about his precautions. "I told you," he said, "you spoiled your Bible.
paragraphs.zh: 狄克手里还拿着《圣经》，四处张望，显得十分害怕，却找不到同情的目光。塞利弗甚至开了个玩笑取笑他的小心谨慎：“我跟你说过吧，”他说，“你把《圣经》弄糟了。”

paragraphs.en: A sperrit wouldn't want it for anything!"
paragraphs.zh: “连鬼魂都不想要！”

paragraphs.en: Despite this, Dick remained troubled. The fever predicted by Dr. Livesey was clearly worsening due to heat and exhaustion.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，迪克仍然心神不安。利维斯医生预测的发烧显然因为酷热和疲劳而加重了。

paragraphs.en: We continued our descent from the summit. The pines were sparse, and even between clusters of nutmeg and azalea, vast open spaces baked in the sun. Approaching from near north-west, we drew closer to the Spy-glass's shoulder while widening our view over the western bay.
paragraphs.zh: 我们继续从山顶往下走。松树稀疏，即便在肉桂和杜鹃花丛中，大片空旷的地方也在阳光下曝晒。从西北方向接近时，我们逐渐靠近望远镜的侧面，同时视野也渐渐延伸到了西边的海湾。

paragraphs.en: The first tall tree was identified as incorrect by its bearing. The second also failed. The third towered nearly two hundred feet above a clump of undergrowth, resembling a giant with a red trunk as thick as a cottage and a wide shadow large enough for a company to maneuver in.
paragraphs.zh: 第一棵高大的树因方位不对被确认为错误，第二棵同样未能通过。第三棵树则矗立在一片灌木丛中，高达近二百英尺，仿佛一个巨人的红色躯干，粗壮得像一栋小屋，其宽大的阴影足可让一家公司穿梭其中。

paragraphs.en: It stood out both east and west, making it an obvious landmark.
paragraphs.zh: 它东西两侧都十分显眼，成了一个明显的地标。

paragraphs.en: Now, the companions' focus shifted entirely from their earlier fears to the promise of wealth. The thought of seven hundred thousand pounds in gold buried beneath its shadow consumed them. Their eyes glowed with greed; they moved faster and lighter; all their thoughts were on that fortune, a lifetime of luxury and pleasure.
paragraphs.zh: 现在，同伴们的注意力完全从之前的恐惧转移到了财富的诱惑上。想到地下埋藏着七十万英镑黄金的承诺，让他们心旌摇动。他们的眼睛闪烁着贪婪的光芒，动作更快也更轻盈；脑海中只有那笔财宝，一生的奢华与享乐。

paragraphs.en: Silver hobbled along, grunting on his crutch. Flies settled on his hot face, causing him to curse furiously. He struggled against the line holding him to me, occasionally casting deadly glances my way.
paragraphs.zh: Silver一瘸一拐地走着，拄着拐杖发出哼哧声。苍蝇停在他的热脸上，让他咒骂不已。他挣扎着摆脱束缚住他的那条线，偶尔还恶狠狠地朝我这边瞥来几眼。

paragraphs.en: His thoughts were clear: in the immediate presence of gold, all else was forgotten. His promise and the doctor's warning were irrelevant. He hoped to seize the treasure, board the HISPANIOLA under cover of night, and sail away with both riches and crimes.
paragraphs.zh: 他的思绪十分清晰：在金子面前，其他一切都烟消云散。他早已把诺言和医生的警告抛诸脑后。他渴望抢夺宝藏，在夜色掩护下登上“希帕尼奥拉”号，带着财宝和罪行一起远航。

paragraphs.en: I struggled to keep up with the treasure hunters' rapid pace. Silver pulled roughly at the rope whenever I stumbled, his eyes filled with murderous intent. Dick, lagging behind us, muttered prayers and curses as his fever worsened.
paragraphs.zh: 我努力跟上那些寻宝者的快速步伐。每当我不慎绊倒，银会粗暴地拉扯绳子，眼中满是杀意。落后于我们的迪克嘴里喃喃念着祈祷和咒骂，随着病情加重，声音越来越嘶哑。

paragraphs.en: We reached the edge of a thicket. Merry shouted, "Huzza, mates, all together!" The frontiersmen broke into a run.
paragraphs.zh: 我们来到了一片灌木丛的边缘。梅里喊道：“好啊，伙计们，一起冲！”那些拓荒者们随即加快了脚步，开始了奔跑。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, not ten yards ahead, they stopped. A low cry echoed. Silver sped up, using his crutch like a madman.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，在他们前方不到十码的地方停了下来。一声低呼回荡开来。Silver像疯了一样加快了步伐，拐杖在他手中挥舞得飞快。

paragraphs.en: We halted beside a large excavation with broken pick shafts and scattered packing-case boards. On one board was the name "WALRUS," Flint's ship.
paragraphs.zh: 我们停在了一个巨大的挖掘坑旁，坑内散落着断裂的撬棍和散乱的包装箱木板。其中一块木板上写着“Walrus”，那是弗林特的船的名字。

paragraphs.en: The cache had been found and plundered; the seven hundred thousand pounds were gone!
paragraphs.zh: 藏起来的财宝被发现了并且被洗劫一空！那七十万英镑不翼而飞了！
